title: Insight dashboard crashes when exporting a chart to Excel
body:
Every time I export a chart from the Insight sales dashboard to Excel, the browser tab shows "Aw, Snap! Something went wrong" and the dashboard reloads.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Open Insight > Sales > Monthly Revenue
2. Set the date range to Jan 2026 - Sep 2026
3. Click the chart menu (three dots) > Export > Excel (.xlsx)
4. The tab crashes after about 3 seconds

Exporting the same chart to PNG works. Exporting with a range of 3 months or less also works. Chrome 141 on Windows 11.

I'm taking screenshots for the board deck for now, but I need the numbers in Excel.
